winks.rationale: The name 'Bryce' is exactly the name of Bryce Canyon and Bryce Canyon National Park in Utah.
'Londyn' is a respelling of London, which is also a real US town (e.g. London, Kentucky and London, Ohio).
'Augusta' is itself the name of multiple US places, most notably Augusta, Georgia and Augusta, Maine.
The word 'Teresa' reads directly into Santa Teresa, New Mexico, a real community.
'Mark' reads into the town/refuge name St. Marks, Florida (faint, as 'Mark' alone is generic).
'Smith' is a real place name, e.g. Smith River, California, though it is an extremely common word.
'Richard' reads into Richardson, a real Texas city, though the connection is loose.
Very faint sound-alike; 'Brian' is mostly just a common first name with no clean US place match.
Faint sound-alike of the common town name Andover; not a clean plain reading.
'Beatty' is exactly the name of Beatty, Nevada, a real town near Death Valley.
'Lauren' reads into Laurens, South Carolina, a real town and county seat.
'Zach' reads into Zachary, Louisiana, a real city; loose because it relies on the full name.
